pytest: pytest: the test runner this pack reads, and the module its fixture decorator and markers come from
test: suss: code-unit kind; also pytest: the default python_functions prefix of a test function
Test: pytest: the default python_classes prefix of a class of tests
setUp: unittest: the method a TestCase runs before each test
asyncSetUp: unittest: the coroutine an IsolatedAsyncioTestCase runs before each test
name: suss: the syntax field every adapter reads a definition's name from; also pytest: the keyword on pytest.fixture that gives the fixture another name
autouse: pytest: the keyword on pytest.fixture that runs it before every test in its scope
pytestmark: pytest: the module or class variable whose markers apply to every test under it
self: language: the instance a method is called on
cls: language: the class a class method is called on
request: pytest: the parameter a fixture takes to read the test that requested it
mocker: pytest-mock: the fixture that hands a test its patchers
patch: pytest-mock: mocker.patch, the same as unittest.mock.patch
monkeypatch: pytest: the fixture that sets attributes for the length of a test
setattr: pytest: monkeypatch.setattr, which replaces an attribute given a dotted path or an object and a name
